findings.issue: Commit 30ac5b51f95 added five intent_signals to graph-metadata.json at positions 30-34 ("depth-capped frontier", "follow-up question frontier", "frontier of follow-up questions", "review target", "this research run"). It did not regenerate the tracked compiled .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/skill-graph.json, which still holds the 30-signal list for system-deep-loop (generated_at 2026-11-17T11:29:50). The freshness check reports SIGNAL DRIFT compiled vs disk: system-deep-loop and exits 1 under --strict. Reach: any pull request to main that touches .skilled/skills/*/graph-metadata.json or hub-router.json runs the paths filter at .github/workflows/routing-registry-drift.yml lines 71-109. That workflow's step 'Compiled skill graph freshness - compiled json matches graph-metadata' (line 244) runs this exact command with set -euo pipefail, so the CI gate fails. Live routing is not affected: skill_advisor.py merges the source graph-metadata signals at load time (lines 1388-1391 and 1451-1452). Fix: regenerate with the command the script names, python3 .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/skill_graph_compiler.py --export-json, then commit the refreshed skill-graph.json.
